page_omission_audit.finding: Read full cover. Authored date and addressed August draft are provenance; delivery and exact draft bytes are not inferred.
Read all overview requests. Material developed premises are covered below; requested standards and protection priorities are preferences.
Training media, legal adequacy and task-dependent limits are covered by 001–005; future suitability and design requests are not realised outcomes.
Practical training, DGUV requirements and medical consultation are covered by 004–007; proposed legal safeguards do not independently assert measured failures.
Confirmation, publication status, effectiveness, review intervals and hazard categories are covered by 008–017; four-year interval and authentication design are proposals.
PPE hierarchy, definitions, existing restriction and sanctions are covered by 018–022; preferred wording and rest periods are recommendations.
Mobile healthcare, portable technical controls and employer coordination are covered by 023–026; proposed equivalent-control architecture is normative.
Data protection, secrecy, register duties and ZED service status are covered by 027–033 and 057. Current legal bases are kept separate from historical drafting and service claims.
Retention, protein seeds, scope/exposure distinctions and ubiquitous thresholds are covered by 034–039; ABAS assessment requests and possible future exclusions are not established effects.

Recommended measures and authorisation/notification distinctions are covered by 040–042. Portal design, free access, accessibility and interoperability are requested features, not proven current failures.

Annex identity, area versus apparatus, HEPA rows, deadlines, burden estimates and commencement are covered by 043–048. Staggered implementation is a policy preference; isolated rows do not prove general non-compliance.
Dynamic references, instrument type, SME denominators, cost-model scope and recurring costs/evaluation are covered by 049–055. Draft assumptions are not observed savings.
Defined form versus rationale is covered by 056 with the charitable medium-choice interpretation. Minor typo and citation cleanup, preferred drafting and conclusion are incidental or normative.
Read full bibliography, contact block and organisational description. Bibliographic listings are not evidence that a substantive proposition is correct; no independent material premise omitted.
